english_context.text: Ibn `Abbas, `Ata,' Mujahid, `Ikrimah and Al-Hasan all said, "This means with this the Budn should be sacrificed." Qatadah, Muhammad bin Ka`b Al-Qurazi, Ad-Dahhak, Ar-Rabi`, `Ata' Al-Khurasani, Al-Hakam, Isma`il bin Abi Khalid and others from the Salaf have all said the same.

findings: G1 carries five named attributions; G2 carries seven more. Both have the identical Arabic span/hash, so two evidence rows are analytical group projections, not two independent witnesses.
Arabic ونحوها includes similar animals; captured English names Budn without explicitly translating this extension. Retain bounded fidelity difference.
Unqualified Ata and Ata al-Khurasani remain separate printed labels; no identity merger established.
No chain printed in this cluster; unknown independence remains.
decision: Retain twelve named propositions and existing five/seven evidence-link split. Do not multiply witness counts or delete distinct authorities.
